propositions: Batched overlap-judge calls inherit generic 16,000-token, three-generation, four-transport-attempt, and 600-second budgets without operation-local bounds, causing multi-minute retry loops before safe abstention on malformed responses.

RunRequest lacks lowering-only seams for structured-retry attempts, transport attempts, and request timeout, permitting three full generations and multiple transport retries before advisory catch executes.
Applying output-token limits alone is insufficient to contain latency; schema validation acts only after malformed payload exists, requiring separate constraints on retry attempts and elapsed time.

Repair extends RunRequest budget contract with lowering-only per-request seams, applies effective config before model construction, and assigns overlap-judge explicit advisory budgets: 1,024 output tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, and 60-second timeout.
Timeout and truncation events must degrade to exact all-candidate abstention without fabricated overlap findings, as required by story 9022 and ADR 0086.
